Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! A fitting farewell then for Masakadza and also, Zimbabwe end the series on a high. However, we have two more games left in this series, one is of course, the final between Bangladesh and Afghanistan. And the other is two days before that - the last league game, involving Bangladesh and Afghanistan again and it begins at 1830 local (1230 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

Hamilton Masakadza, the Zimbabwe skipper comes in for the chat. He says that he is feeling amazing after the win. Adds that he knew the side always had it in them. On asked about their first win against Afghanistan, Masakadza says that it is quite special to pull off a win in his last game. He adds that the team showed lot of fight and they have worked hard from the start. On asked about his entire career, he says that there have been lots of ups and downs. Adds that it is a very special feeling. He also remembers his first Test win as a captain. Masakadza says that he will continue serving Zimbabwe Cricket in whatever capacity he can. He thanks everyone who played a massive role throughout his career.

MAN OF THE MATCH, CHRIS MPOFU, says that he enjoyed bowling on the surface. He adds that on this wicket, taking the pace of the ball helped him. He finishes on by saying that whatever they did went their way.

It's time for the Afghanistan skipper to talk about the game. Rashid  starts by saying that they had a great start but couldn't finish it the way they should have. He says that they had a lot of positives in the game and they will take those to the finals. Rashid points that, they are giving opportunities to the youngsters ahead of the T20 World Cup. Rashid opines that the side has different players who can play in different formats. Rashid finishes by saying that they have players who can adapt in all three formats as well which pleases him.

First up, the Zimbabwe skipper Hamilton Masakadza gets a memento for his contribution for the relations between Zimbabwe and Bangladesh. He also gets a memento from Zimbabwe Cricket for his contribution to the game.

Earlier in the day, the Zimbabwe bowlers did extremely well to pull things back after they were taken to the cleaners in the first half of their innings with the ball. That effort in the second half kept Zimbabwe in check and the Rhodesian side bagged their first win of the tournament. Stay tuned for the presentation.

The Afghanistan bowling looked off color today. Maybe they were a touch complacent. None of their bowlers looked at their best. When only one of their spinners takes a wicket, you probably know they haven't been at their best. Overall, not something Rashid Khan will be happy with.

Chasing a total which we thought would be tricky on a wicket which is slightly slow, the Zimbabwe team have done it quite easily. Right from the word go they looked in control of the chase. First, it was the openers who got them off to a brisk start. Then, Chakabva and Masakadza continued the good work with another excellent stand. The skipper got to his fifty, he would have wanted to stay there till the end but could not do so. Chakabva also perished but till then, the game was completely in Zimbabwe's favor. Williams and Mutombodzi ensured there were no more wickets to fall and they took the team over the line.

What a way to end your career! It is under his captaincy, Zimbabwe beat Afghanistan for the first time in T20Is. It is under his captaincy, the long winning streak in T20Is for Afghanistan has been broken and majority of the credit has to be given to Masakadza as he is the hero for his side in this chase.
Good length ball down the leg side, Williams pulls it towards fine leg for a single and with that,  ZIMBABWE WIN THE GAME BY SEVEN WICKETS!
Short delivery outside off, Sean slaps this towards covers for nothing. One more run still required from four balls.
Short delivery outside off, Williams pushes this to mid off.
WIDE! SCORES LEVEL! Zadran bowls a full delivery down the leg side, Williams looks to flick it but misses it.
Dawlat Zadran to bowl the final over. Zimbabwe need 2 runs.
Short ball on off, Williams pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a single. Two more runs required from the last over.
BEATEN! Quicker delivery outside off, Williams looks to drive but misses the ball.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Flat delivery on off, Mutombodzi looks to defend but it hits the inside edge and onto the pads.
Short ball outside off, Williams punches this off the back foot towards the off side for a single.
WIDE! Rashid bowls a quicker delivery down the leg side, Williams looks to flick but misses.
BEATEN! Quicker delivery outside off, Williams looks to cut but misses the ball completely. The ball was too close to cut and that's why Williams missed it.
Williams flicks this fuller one off his pads to mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Another boundary in the over and Zimbabwe are on course for their first win in the Tri-Series. Mujeeb bowls short and Williams slogs through the line and finds the gap to perfection as the fielder from long on running to his left cannot reach the ball as it crosses the fence.
Fuller one on pads, Williams works it to mid-wicket and takes a couple.
FOUR! You drop and I hit. Williams rocks on the back foot to cut this short one from Mujeeb past the point fielder to fetch a boundary.

OHH! DROPPED! What have you done Mujeeb? He bowls a fuller one outside off, and Williams goes for a drive but hits it uppishly back towards the bowler only for Mujeeb to drop an easy chance in his followthrough.
Tinotenda Mutombodzi is the new man in!

OUT! CAUGHT! The skipper is always busy. If not in the wickets column then assists his players by holding onto catches. Mujeeb goes flatter and Chakabva slogs him across the line only to find the fielder in the deep. That's another blow as Zimbabwe loose another set batsman.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is back on!
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single. Only 17 runs required off the last three overs.

SIX! Flat six from Chakabva here! Floated ball on off, Chakabva goes on knees and slog sweeps this between the long on and deep mid-wicket region for a flat six. Zimbabwe getting closer and closer to the target.
Floated delivery on middle, Williams plays a reverse sweep towards deep point where Mujeeb makes the stop. The batters take a single.
The batsman gets a leading edge on that one.
Flighted delivery around off, Williams attempts to play the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. The Afgan players go in for an appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Flighted delivery on middle, Chakabva flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Rashid returns for his third over. Can the skipper get a couple of quick wickets?
Floated ball on off, Williams looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads. 10 runs have come off the over.
Flatter delivery on middle, Chakabva punches this to long on and takes a single.
Short ball on middle, Chakabva pulls it towards the square leg region for a couple.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
SIX! Confident hit from Chakabva! Comes down the track and lofts this flighted delivery on off towards the long on region for a maximum. The equation is now down to 29 runs off 28 balls.
Full delivery on off, Williams drives this to long on and takes a single.

Good length ball outside off, Williams drives this to mid off and takes a quick single. Nabi has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Smart cricket from Zimbabwe as they got six easy singles in that over.
Good length delivery on middle, Regis flicks it towards mid-wicket and crosses over for another single.
Full delivery on off, Williams looks to drive but it goes uppishly towards mid off on the bounce. The batters take a single.
Full delivery on middle, Chakabva comes down the track and plays it towards the long on region for another single.
Full delivery on middle, Williams flicks it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a single. They think of a couple but decide against it.
Full delivery outside off, Chakabva moves towards the off side and plays it towards the long on region for a single.
Gulbadin Naib into the attack now!
Short ball outside off, Chakabva punches this towards the off side for a single. 42 runs required off the last 6 overs.
Full delivery around off, Williams drives it through mid off and crosses over for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated delivery on middle, Williams defends it off the front foot.
Flatter delivery on middle, Chakabva flicks it towards mid-wicket where Gulbadin makes a good diving stop. The batters take a single.
Full delivery on off, Williams drives this to long off and gets off the mark with a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Sean Williams is the next man in!

OUT! CAUGHT! That is the end of Masakadza's last knock in international cricket. Not after a fine, fine knock though. He is congratulated by the Afghan teammates as he walks back. Excellent gesture from the fielding side. The whole Zimbabwe dressing room is on its feet as their skipper makes his way back to the dug out. He will be disappointed that he was not there till the end but has taken his side on top. Zadran is the man who gets him and it is a much-needed breakthrough for Afghanistan. He goes for the slower one and bowls it on a good length. Masakadza looks to go big but is not completely in control of the shot. He ends up hitting it high up in the air. As soon as he hit he knew  he was a goner. The fielder in the long on region settles under it and takes an easy one.
Fuller one on the pads, Chakabva flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A low full toss on the stumps, Masakadza walks across and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and on middle, Masakadza misses his flick and wears the blow on the pads.
Length and on off, Masakadza looks to flick it to the leg side but misses it.
Dawlat Zadran comes back on.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total. They need only 48 runs from 48 balls. Should be easy peasy for Zimbabwe from hereon.
Short ball outside off, Masakadza punches this ball off the back foot.
SIX! Masakadza dealing in boundaries here! Poor bowling from Rashid! Short ball on middle, Hamilton rocks back and pulls it hard towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.

FOUR! Full delivery on middle, Hamilton looks to drive it but it goes off the inside half of his bat towards long on. The fielder at long on runs and tries to make a diving stop but does not make the stop. The ball rolls on towards the fence. 100 runs up for Zimbabwe.
Short delivery on middle, Hamilton punches this off the back foot.
Full delivery on middle, Chakabva flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, Chakabva works it towards mid-wicket for a single. 13 runs came off the over.
FOUR! Some innovation there from Chakabva! Fazal bowls a full delivery on middle, Chakabva bends on his knees and plays a paddle sweep over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batters have run through for a single.

FOUR! Hammered! Good length delivery on off, Hamilton lofts this nicely down the ground and past the bowler for a boundary.  50-run partnership is up between the two. An excellent one here which has helped the Rhodesians get close to the target.
WIDE! Very full delivery down the leg side, Hamilton looks to play a paddle sweep but is unable to put any bat on it.
Good length delivery on middle, Chakabva flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Full delivery on middle and leg, Masakadza drives this towards long on and takes a single.
Fazal Niazai, the debutant comes into the attack.
Chakabva flicks this fuller one off his pads straight to square leg. End of first over from the birthday boy Rashid Khan.
Masakadza is playing a responsible innings here. He works this flatter one off his pads but gets an inside edge past the square leg fielder for a single.
Chakabva flicks this fuller one to square leg and crosses for a single.
Flighted one and Masakadza pushes it to mid on for a single.
Flatter one on off, Masakadza rocks on the back foot only to get it off the bottom half of the bat back to bowler.
Leg break on middle, Chakabva pushes it to mid-wicket for a single.
Rashid Khan, the birthday boy is on now. He will have to show his magic to stop his opposite number who looks in a blitzing form.

FIFTY! Masakadza is playing a gem of an innings in his last game. Single-handedly taking his team to victory at the moment. 11th T20I half ton for him. He though knows his job is not done as of now. He would love to stay there till the end and take his team over the line. That would probably be the perfect end to his career. He gets there by pushing this back of a length delivery through covers for a couple.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Short delivery outside off, Hamilton cuts this nicely towards the extra cover region for a couple. Hamilton moves to 49 with this single.

SIX! Excellent batting this from Masakadza. He is surely making a statement here in his last innings. Comes down the track to this flighted delivery on middle and lofts this over the long off fielder for a maximum. Although he did not time it well but it still had enough to go past the ropes.
FOUR! Bludgeoned! Short delivery on off, Masakadza pulls it hard down the ground for a boundary. The fielder at long on had no chance in cutting it off.
Full delivery on off, Chakabva flicks it towards mid-wicket for a quick single.

FOUR! Masakadza is on fire in his last innings. Naib goes full on the pads and Hamilton paddle sweeps it past the man at short fine leg. The ball beats the dive of the short fine fielder and races to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Another one on the pads, and Chakabva flicks it to mid-wicket but gets a single this time as the fielder in the deep is really quick.
Chakabva flicks this length ball to mid-wicket and calls for a couple and they get it in the end easily.
Back of a length and on off, Masakadza pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and around off, Chakabva pushes it to covers for a single.
Fuller one on middle, Masakadza goes for a sweep but cannot time it well. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen cross for a run.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad. Not a great start from Nabi as he gave away 11 runs from it.
WIDE! Nabi bowls another one down the leg side, Chakabva looks to flick but fails to put any bat on it.
Short delivery on middle, Masakadza pulls it towards the leg side for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, Masakadza defends it back to the bowler off the back foot.

SIX! Well played that from Masakadza! Flighted delivery on middle, Masakadza lofts this nicely over the deep mid-wicket fence for another maximum. Masakadza is looking really good here in his last innings.
Flighted delivery on middle, Chakabva plays it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
WIDE! Nabi starts with a ball down the leg side. Hamilton looks to flick but misses.
Mohammad Nabi to bowl now.
Mohammad Nabi to bowl now.

Back of a length delivery on middle, Masakadza drives this towards mid off and takes a quick single. Good start from Zimbabwe as they have added 43 runs in the Powerplay with a loss of only one wicket.
Good length delivery on middle, Chakabva flicks it away towards the leg side for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Chakabva defends it off the front foot back to the bowler.
Good length ball outside off, Chakabva leaves the ball alone.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Good length delivery outside off, Hamilton cuts it towards backward point uppishly. The fielder there fumbles and allows a single.
Gulbadin Naib comes into the attack. Regis Chakabva is the new man in to partner his skipper.

OUT! Mujeeb gets the breakthrough! Taylor's dodged stay comes to an end. Mujeeb the Powerplay specialist gets the first wicket. He tosses one up and Taylor cannot resist himself and goes for a wild swing. He connects well, gets the distance but fails to get the elevation and Najibullah Zadran standing at deep mid-wicket takes an easy grab.

Flatter one outside off, Taylor goes for the cut but misses it as the ball goes past the bat. A lot of Ohhs and Ahhs! Replays later on showed that there was a faint outside edge on that. Lucky for Taylor.
Fuller one on pads, Masakadza flicks it to mid on for a single.
Masakadza looks to cut this flatter one on off but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Tossed up on middle, Taylor flicks this uppisly wide of mid on for a run.
Flatter one on middle, Taylor goes for the slog but fails to connect wood on the ball and gets hit on the pads.

SIX! Hamilton now joins the action! Zadran bowls a good length delivery on middle, Masakadza slogs it away to the square leg region for another maximum. Excellent start for Zimbabwe.  Probably the first time in the series that Zimbabwe have started well in the series.
Good length delivery on middle, Taylor flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
FOUR! Nicely played from Taylor! Good length ball outside off, Taylor rocks back and plays it over the cover fielder for a boundary.

Good length delivery around off, Taylor looks to paddle it but it goes off his pads towards short fine leg. Masakadza looks to take a single but is not there. The fielder at short fine leg has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Lucky escape for the Zimbabwe skipper here.
Good length ball outside off, Masakadza drives this towards mid off and takes a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Flighted delivery on middle, Taylor attempts to play a slog but it goes off the inside half towards deep square leg for a single.
Flat delivery on middle, Taylor pushes this back to the bowler.
Full delivery on middle, Taylor defends it back to the bowler.
Quicker delivery around off, Masakadza pushes it towards point and takes off for a quick single.
Flatter delivery on off, Masakadza comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler.
Sensible batting from the Zimbabwe skipper as he flicks this fuller one off his pads to mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Humongous! This is Masakadza. He sweeps Zadran and gets the maximum result for his shot. Zadran bowls one in the slot and at 135 kph it is not going to trouble Hamilton. He goes down on one knee and slogs him high and over the deep backward square leg fence for a maximum.
Masakadza flicks this length ball on the pads to mid-wicket and takes a couple. Rashid Khan from mid on gives the chase and saves a couple there.
Length and outside off, Taylor looks to cut but gets an under edge which goes past the leg pole and towards fine leg. A single taken.
Length ball outside off, Taylor defends it back to the bowler.
On a length and on middle, a hint of swing too. Masakadza looks to push it to the leg side but gets rapped on the thigh pad of the inside edge. A run taken.
Dawlat Zadran to bowl from the other end.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad. Excellent start for Zimbabwe. 12 runs have come off it.
Loopy delivery on middle, Masakadza flicks it towards the leg side for another single.
Full delivery on middle, Masakadza defends it off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on middle, Taylor flicks it towards the leg side for a single.

SIX! First a boundary and it is followed by a maximum. Excellent batting from Taylor here. Mujeeb bowls a full delivery on middle, Taylor plays a lofted shot over the long on region for the first six of the innings. Mujeeb was carted around in the last match that they played against Zimbabwe and it has not started well for him here as well.
FOUR! Poor start from Mujeeb here! Mujeeb bowls a delivery way down the leg side, Taylor just helps it away towards the fine leg region for a boundary. Good start for Zimbabwe.

We are back for the run chase! The Afghan players are out in the middle.  They have the Zimbabwe players as well with them as they have come out to give a guard of honor to Hamilton Masakadza. Brendon Taylor will partner his skipper at the start. Mujeeb Ur Rahman to start the proceedings for the Afghans.
